tbesh_html:
Gath-rimmon = "winepress of the pomegranate"
a town of the half tribe of Manasseh located on the west side of the Jordan, assigned to the Levites
Another name of yiv.le.am (יִבְלְעָם "Ibleam" H2991)

strongs_1890.derivation: from H1660 (גַּת) and H7416 (רִמּוֹן); wine-press of (the) pomegranate;
